-- Refactor task compose_config to use compose_config table
BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE task ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS compose_config_id uuid NULL;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_task_compose_config') THEN
        ALTER TABLE task ADD CONSTRAINT fk_task_compose_config FOREIGN KEY (compose_config_id) REFERENCES compose_config(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
    END IF;
END $$;

-- Backfill compose_config_id from task.compose_config (if legacy column exists)
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_name = 'task' AND column_name = 'compose_config'
    ) THEN
        EXECUTE $sql$
            WITH task_configs AS (
                SELECT DISTINCT compose_config AS config
                FROM task
                WHERE compose_config IS NOT NULL
            ),
            existing AS (
                SELECT config, (ARRAY_AGG(id ORDER BY id))[1] AS id
                FROM compose_config
                GROUP BY config
            ),
            to_insert AS (
                SELECT tc.config
                FROM task_configs tc
                LEFT JOIN existing e ON e.config = tc.config
                WHERE e.id IS NULL
            ),
            ins AS (
                INSERT INTO compose_config (id, config, created_at)
                SELECT uuid_generate_v4(), config, now()
                FROM to_insert
                RETURNING id, config
            ),
            map AS (
                SELECT id, config FROM existing
                UNION ALL
                SELECT id, config FROM ins
            )
            UPDATE task t
            SET compose_config_id = m.id
            FROM map m
            WHERE t.compose_config IS NOT NULL AND t.compose_config = m.config
        $sql$;
    END IF;
END $$;

ALTER TABLE task DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS compose_config;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_compose_config_id ON task(compose_config_id);

COMMIT;
